name: shohoz-krishi
description: Shohoz Krishi — single-vendor online store. Next.js storefront + admin (ShohozKrishi_Client) and Express API (ShohozKrishi_Server).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Server install && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Client install
scripts.dev:api: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Server run start:dev
scripts.dev:web: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Client run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Server run build && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Client run build
scripts.build:api: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Server run build
scripts.build:web: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKrishi_Client run build
scripts.typecheck: cd ShohozKrishi_Server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ShohozKrishi_Client && npx tsc --noEmit
